title: WHAT IS GIDA? HOW ARE YOU ORGANIZED?
answer: GIDA stands for Gestione Impianti Depurazione Acque. It is a mixed public-private joint-stock company with a turnover of about 17 million euros per year, made up of 66 employees coordinated by a General Manager. In turn, the Management reports to a Board of Directors consisting of 9 members, 5 of whom are public and 4 private. The work activity takes place in a continuous cycle 365 days a year, to guarantee efficiency and environmental safety.
